# Fonts (shipped in the APK)

The Porcelain type scale uses two variable fonts, copied unchanged from the google/fonts repository into
`app/src/main/res/font/`. Both are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (texts in this folder).

| Font | Used for | File in the app | Source | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Geist (wght axis) | interface text, labels, numbers | `res/font/geist.ttf` | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/geist | 73894e0448cae90a92b6c2f8732b7bb9acb7b94c418bff559dad4a18e1de9659 |
| Newsreader (opsz, wght axes) | serif titles and headline tails | `res/font/newsreader.ttf` | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/newsreader | 8a08d13f8a6c0d51be379a60af84f945f65369a67e509ee3c3bdcc421254d7c1 |
